description: React component for editing slash commands in Mattermost integrations, including UI rendering, command validation, and confirmation modal handling.

classes.name: EditCommand
classes.description: React component class for editing commands with confirmation modal and form handling.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches team commands on mount if commands are enabled.

methods.name: editCommand
methods.description: Handles editing of a command, prompts confirmation if critical fields change.

methods.name: submitCommand
methods.description: Submits the edited command, navigates on success, handles errors.

methods.name: renderExtra
methods.description: Renders the confirmation modal with messages.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main component UI, including loading state and command form.
